breakdown.description: The `turbulenceProperties` dictionary specifies both `simulationType LES` and a `RAS` sub-dictionary. A simulation can be either LES or RANS, but not both simultaneously in this manner.
breakdown.reason: The user incorrectly requested to configure the simulation with both LES and RANS models simultaneously. The ground truth corrected this by specifying only an LES model. The generated specification successfully resolved this inconsistency by explicitly stating, 'Set the simulationType to LES in constant/turbulenceProperties. Do not include any RAS sub-dictionary.'
